errors.text_span: подредени в азбучен ред на български език
errors.evidence: The description claims the countries on the x-axis are sorted alphabetically, but they are sorted in descending order of their corresponding values. For instance, the sequence starts with Нидерландия (N), Обединено... (O), Дания (D), which is not alphabetical.
The description states that the lowest value for Romania is around 0.4000, but the bar for Romania in the chart is clearly above the 0.6000 line.

errors.text_span: което отговаря на азбучния ред на държавите
errors.evidence: This part of the sentence incorrectly attributes the gradual decrease in bar height to an alphabetical sorting of the countries. The decrease is due to the data being sorted by value in descending order.
